beats.say: Ten teams copy the same twelve files and change three lines.
Then one fix must be made in ten places.
beats.label: The pain
beats.head: One fix, ten places

beats.say: This port has three steps: use a chart, write a chart, and choose your tool.
beats.label: Port 11 · Helm

check.prompt: An upgrade breaks your release. What takes you back?
check.why: Helm keeps every revision of a release. A rollback applies an older one.

beats.say: A chart is a set of templates with a version. Values fill the blanks.
beats.label: Chart
beats.head: Templates plus values

beats.say: Each install is a release. Helm keeps every revision of it.
beats.label: Release
beats.head: A release has revisions

beats.say: So an upgrade that goes wrong is one rollback away.
beats.label: Safety
beats.head: Upgrade, or roll back

beats.say: Second: write one chart for all teams.
Put good defaults in the values file. Each team changes only what differs.
beats.label: values.yaml
beats.head: Good defaults, few overrides

beats.say: Render the chart before you install it. Read the output.
beats.label: A habit
beats.head: Render first, then install

beats.say: Helm packages software for others. Kustomize patches your own files.
beats.label: The rule
beats.head: Helm packages. Kustomize patches.

beats.say: A chart is templates plus values. A release has revisions. Render before you install.
beats.label: Helm

beats.say: Now start the first lesson below.
